summary.text: Jo Doll is a Democratic state representative from Missouri House of Representatives District 91 and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A physical therapist, she holds bachelor's and master's degrees from Washington University.

paragraphs.text: Jo Doll was born in Kansas City, Missouri, and lives in Webster Groves, Missouri.
She earned a bachelor's degree in psychology in 1990 and a master's degree in physical therapy in 1992 from Washington University, and her career experience includes working as a physical therapist.
Doll advanced from the August 4, 2026 Democratic primary.

Her 2025-2026 committee assignments are as ranking minority member of the Professional Registration and Licensing Committee and of the Legislative Review Committee, and as a member of the Joint Committee on Administrative Rules.
